title: Pure Numeron
summary: Pure Numeron going-second OTK and Chaos Gate build with a heavy handtrap and board-breaker suite. Numeron Network copies Numeron Calling directly from the Deck while you control no monsters to summon all four Rank 1 Numeron Gate Xyz Monsters at once.

summary.title: Starters
points: Numeron Wall sends itself from the hand or field to the GY as a Quick Effect while you control no other cards to activate Numeron Network directly from your hand or Deck.

Numeron Network sends any Numeron Normal Spell (Numeron Calling, Numeron Chaos Ritual, or Numeron Storm) from the Deck to the GY during your Main Phase to copy its activation effect, and lets your Numeron Xyz Monsters activate effects that detach materials without detaching.

summary.title: Opening: Numeron Network into 4 Gates
steps: While you control no monsters, activate Numeron Network (or use Numeron Wall to place it from the Deck) and use Network's effect to send Numeron Calling from the Deck to the GY, Special Summoning Number 1: Numeron Gate Ekam, Number 2: Numeron Gate Dve, Number 3: Numeron Gate Trini, and Number 4: Numeron Gate Catvari from the Extra Deck.

Going second for the OTK: crash the Numeron Gates into an opponent's monster one by one; after each battle, the battling Gate doubles the ATK of all Numeron monsters you currently control (without detaching thanks to Numeron Network), escalating their ATK from 1000 to 2000, 4000, and 8000.

Going first or in Main Phase 2 (since Numeron Calling allows only 1 more Normal or Special Summon for the rest of the turn): overlay Number C1: Numeron Chaos Gate Sunya on top of Number 1: Numeron Gate Ekam to banish all monsters on the field, or Link Summon Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax using the four Xyz Gates.

summary.title: Sunya & Numerounius Escalation
summary.text: When Number C1: Numeron Chaos Gate Sunya is Xyz Summoned, it banishes all monsters on the field, then Special Summons itself during your next Standby Phase and inflicts burn damage equal to the combined ATK of your banished Xyz Monsters while Numeron Network is in your Field Zone. If Sunya is destroyed by a monster effect instead, Numeron Chaos Ritual can use Numeron Network and the 4 banished or GY Numeron Gates as Xyz Materials to Xyz Summon Rank 12 Number C1000: Numerounius with 10,000 ATK.

summary.title: Extra Deck Bosses & Lock
points: Number C1000: Numerounius destroys a monster on the field as a Quick Effect on either turn and floats into Rank 13 Number iC1000: Numerounius Numerounia (100,000 ATK/DEF on the opponent's turn, with an alternate win condition if the opponent does not battle it).

Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax, made with the four Numeron Gate Xyz Monsters as your single post-Calling summon, cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, draws all attacks, and gains any battling Special Summoned monster's ATK.
Number 100: Numeron Dragon can be Xyz Summoned by detaching from two same-name, same-Rank Numbers (such as two copies of Ekam) and gains 1000 ATK per Rank on the field.
Summon Lock: After resolving Numeron Calling, you can only Normal or Special Summon once for the rest of that turn.

summary.title: Spells & Handtraps
points: Rank-Up-Magic Numeron Force ranks a Numeron Gate up into Number C1: Numeron Chaos Gate Sunya and negates all other face-up cards on the field.
Numeron Storm destroys all Spells and Traps the opponent controls and burns for 1000 while you control a Numerounius monster.
Because Numeron Wall and Numeron Calling require you to control no monsters, the rest of the Main Deck is filled with monster handtraps and staple board-breaker Spells that go straight to the GY.
